address: 1 chemin di u Fornu (Hameau de Castagneto), San-Martino-di-Lota, 20200, France
bio: A family business clinging to the mountain with a splendid terrace shaded by plane trees overlooking the sea... Exquisite plating, delicious flavours with notes of Corsican saffron and confit of citron, twice-cooked mouth-watering veal or the decadent vacherin dessert perfumed with the one and only Madagascan vanilla, all of which washed down with locally grown vintages....
